useCases.metaDescription: How retail shops, real estate agents, schools, clinics, online stores and agencies in Pakistan use NextReach to market and sell on WhatsApp.

useCases.subtitle: Whatever you sell, your customers are already on WhatsApp. Here's how businesses like yours can use NextReach.

retail.name: Retail shops
retail.summary: Clothing, electronics, furniture and every shop in between.

challenges.c1: New stock arrives, but only walk-in customers hear about it.
challenges.c2: Customers ask for prices and photos one by one, all day.
challenges.c3: Sale announcements get lost in busy family groups.

solutions.s1: Send a new-arrivals campaign with photos to the customers who want it.
solutions.s2: Share one catalog link with prices instead of sending dozens of screenshots.
solutions.s3: See who opened the catalog and follow up with the interested ones.

retail.example: A boutique sends its Eid collection to regular customers on Friday morning. Customers open the catalog from the button, ask about sizes in the shared inbox, and the lead board shows the staff who to call first.

realEstate.name: Real estate

challenges.c1: Enquiries come from many ads, and agents keep them in their own phones.
challenges.c2: Serious buyers and casual browsers look the same in a chat list.
challenges.c3: Following up on every enquiry by hand takes hours.

solutions.s1: Keep every enquiry in one CRM with tags for area, budget and property type.
solutions.s2: Use the lead board to see who is fully interested and ready to visit.
solutions.s3: Let automations follow up with new enquiries and alert an agent if there's no reply.

realEstate.example: A property dealer tags each enquiry by society and budget. When a buyer becomes interested, an automation sends the brochure the next day and alerts the agent if the buyer hasn't replied.

education.name: Education

challenges.c1: Admission season brings a flood of the same questions.
challenges.c2: Parents miss important notices sent by SMS or on paper.
challenges.c3: Front-desk staff can't answer every chat after hours.

solutions.s1: Send admission dates, fee reminders and notices to the right class or group.
solutions.s2: Auto-reply to common questions with your own details, even after hours.
solutions.s3: Track enquiries from first message to enrolment on the lead board.

education.example: An academy groups contacts by class. During admissions, auto-reply answers questions about timings and documents from the academy's own details, and staff pick up the chats that need a person.

clinics.name: Clinics
clinics.summary: Clinics, labs, dentists and wellness centres.

challenges.c1: The phone rings all day with questions about timings and doctors.
challenges.c3: Several receptionists share one phone and lose track of chats.

solutions.s1: Answer common questions automatically using your clinic's own information.
solutions.s2: Send reminders and health-camp announcements with approved templates.
solutions.s3: Give each receptionist their own access in a shared inbox.

clinics.example: A dental clinic sends a reminder template the day before follow-up visits. Patients reply to confirm, and receptionists handle the chats from the shared inbox instead of one phone.

ecommerce.name: E-commerce

challenges.c1: Customers ask the same questions about stock, price and delivery.
challenges.c2: Abandoned interest: people ask, then go quiet.
challenges.c3: It's hard to tell which campaigns actually bring sales.

solutions.s1: Share your catalog with a tap-to-open button in every chat.
solutions.s2: Let AI lead scoring spot buyers, and automations nudge the quiet ones.
solutions.s3: Use reports to see which campaigns were read and replied to.

ecommerce.example: An online store sends a weekend sale campaign. The AI places customers who ask about delivery on the fully interested column, and a follow-up template goes to those who opened the catalog but didn't reply.

about.title: We help Pakistani businesses sell where their customers already are
about.subtitle: Almost every customer in Pakistan has WhatsApp. We build the tools that let businesses use it properly, from the first campaign to the final sale.

story.title: Why we built NextReach
story.p1: Businesses across Pakistan already run on WhatsApp. Orders, enquiries, payments and complaints all arrive in the same chat list, often on one person's phone.
story.p2: That works until it doesn't: messages get missed, broadcasts get ignored, and nobody knows which customer to call back first. We built NextReach to fix that, with WhatsApp's official platform, local payments and copy that makes sense here.

official.description: We use WhatsApp's official platform and Meta's sign-up, so your number and your reputation stay safe.

plain.title: Keep it simple

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Send us a question and we'll reply.
faq.results: {count, plural, =0 {No questions match your search.} one {# question matches your search.} other {# questions match your search.}}
faq.noResultsHint: Try a different word, or ask us directly.

whatIs.a: NextReach is a web app for marketing and selling on WhatsApp. It brings campaigns, a shared inbox, a CRM, catalogs, a lead board, AI replies, automations and reports together in one workspace.

whoFor.a: Small and medium businesses in Pakistan, such as shops, property dealers, schools, clinics and online stores, plus agencies that run WhatsApp marketing for clients.

needs.q: What do I need to get started?
needs.a: A Meta business account and a phone number for WhatsApp Business. NextReach walks you through Meta's official sign-up step by step.

trial.a: Yes. Plans come with a free trial so you can try NextReach before you pay. The length of the trial is shown on each plan.

official.q: Does NextReach use the official WhatsApp platform?
official.a: Yes. You connect through Meta's official sign-up, and campaigns use templates approved by Meta. That keeps your number in good standing.

templates.a: A pre-approved message format that Meta allows businesses to send first, for example an offer or a reminder. Templates can include text and an image or video header.

window.a: After a customer messages you, WhatsApp lets you reply freely for 24 hours. After that, you can only start the conversation again with an approved template. NextReach tracks this on every chat.

quality.a: WhatsApp rates each business number based on how customers respond to its messages. NextReach shows the rating so you can adjust before problems grow.

numbers.q: Can I connect more than one WhatsApp number?
numbers.a: Yes, depending on your plan. Each plan shows how many WhatsApp numbers it includes.

plans.a: Choose a ready-made plan, billed monthly or yearly, or build your own by picking modules and limits. The price updates as you choose.

buildOwn.q: What does “Build your own plan” mean?
buildOwn.a: Pick only the modules you need, such as WhatsApp Marketing and CRM, and choose a size for each limit. You pay for what you pick.

payment.a: With JazzCash, EasyPaisa or bank transfer. Upload your payment receipt in the app and our team approves it.

approval.q: How long does payment approval take?
approval.a: Our team checks receipts as quickly as possible during working hours. You'll see the status in the app, and you can contact us if anything looks wrong.

workspace.q: Who can see my business data?
workspace.a: Each business has its own workspace. Only the people you invite can access it, and only with the permissions you give them.

importing.q: Can I bring my existing contacts?
importing.a: Yes. Import a CSV file and match its columns to contact fields, or add contacts by hand.

team.q: Can I control what each employee can do?
team.a: Yes. Permissions are set per feature, so a salesperson can work in the inbox without seeing billing or settings.

help.a: Send us a question from the contact page. If you create an account on this site, you can follow our replies in one place.

demo.q: Can I see a demo first?
demo.a: Of course. Choose “Book a demo” on the contact page and pick a time that suits you.

agencies.a: Yes. Choose “Partnership / agency” on the contact page and tell us about your clients.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information {company} collects, why, and the choices you have.

intro.title: Who we are
intro.body: {company} (“NextReach”, “we”) runs this website and the NextReach service. Our registered address is {address}. For privacy questions, contact {email}.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: When you contact us or create an account on this website, we collect your name, email address and phone number, the content of your messages and any file you attach. When you use the NextReach app, we process the business and contact information you add to your workspace. We also collect basic technical data, such as your IP address, browser type and pages visited, to keep the site secure and working.

use.title: How we use information
use.body: We use your information to answer your questions, provide and improve the service, process payments, send messages you've asked for, keep accounts secure and meet legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp and Meta
whatsapp.body: The NextReach service connects to the WhatsApp Business Platform operated by Meta. Messages you send and receive through NextReach are processed by Meta under its own terms and policies. Businesses using NextReach are responsible for having their customers' permission to message them.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body: We share information only with service providers that help us run NextReach, such as hosting, email delivery and payment processing, and only as needed for that work. We may disclose information if the law requires it.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes above, or as the law requires. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

security.title: How we protect it
security.body: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, including access controls and encrypted connections. No system is perfectly secure, so please tell us at once if you notice anything unusual.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your personal information, or object to how we use it, by contacting {email}. We will respond within a reasonable time.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This website uses only the cookies it needs to work, such as remembering your language and keeping you signed in. If we turn on analytics, we will tell you and ask first where required.

children.title: Children
children.body: NextReach is a service for businesses and is not intended for children. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the new version here with a new effective date, and tell account holders about important changes.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions about this policy? Email {email} or write to {company}, {address}.

terms.metaDescription: The terms that apply when you use the NextReach website and service.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use this website and the NextReach service provided by {company}.

acceptance.title: Accepting these terms
acceptance.body: By using NextReach, you agree to these terms. If you use NextReach for a business, you confirm that you can accept them on its behalf.

service.title: The service
service.body: NextReach provides tools for WhatsApp marketing, conversations, contacts, catalogs, leads, automations, AI assistance and reporting. Features depend on your plan and may change as we improve the service.

accounts.title: Your account
accounts.body: Keep your login details safe and tell us at once about any unauthorised use. You are responsible for activity in your workspace, including that of the employees you invite.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You must follow the law and the WhatsApp Business policies set by Meta. Only message people who have agreed to hear from you. Do not send spam, misleading or harmful content, or use NextReach to break anyone's rights.

payments.title: Plans and payments
payments.body: Prices are shown in the app. Payments are made by JazzCash, EasyPaisa or bank transfer and confirmed by our team after you upload a receipt. Your plan starts once payment is approved.

trials.title: Free trials
trials.body: Free trials let you try NextReach for the period shown on the plan. At the end of a trial, you need an approved payment to keep using paid features.

cancellation.title: Renewal and cancellation
cancellation.body: Plans run for the period you paid for. You can choose not to renew at any time. Refunds follow our Refund Policy.

content.title: Your content
content.body: You own the content and contact data you add to NextReach. You give us permission to process it only to provide the service to you.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: We work hard to keep NextReach running, but we cannot promise it will always be available or free of errors. Parts of the service depend on Meta and other providers.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the extent the law allows, NextReach is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the three months before the claim.

termination.title: Suspension and termination
termination.body: We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms or put other users, Meta's platform or NextReach at risk. You may stop using NextReach at any time.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan. Courts in Pakistan have jurisdiction over any dispute.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. We will post the new version here with a new effective date, and tell account holders about important changes.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email {email} or write to {company}, {address}.

refund.metaDescription: When and how you can request a refund for a NextReach plan.
refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: We want you to be happy with NextReach. This policy explains when refunds are available and how to ask for one.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Because every plan comes with a free trial, we encourage you to try NextReach fully before you pay.

trials.title: Free trials
trials.body: Free trials are free. You are never charged for a trial, so there is nothing to refund.

eligible.title: When you can get a refund
eligible.body: You can request a refund if you were charged the wrong amount, paid twice, or could not use the service because of a problem on our side that we could not fix.

notEligible.title: When refunds are not available
notEligible.body: Refunds are not usually available for partly used billing periods, for changing your mind after the trial, or for accounts suspended for breaking our Terms of Service.

request.title: How to request a refund
request.body: Contact us from the contact page or at {email} with your payment receipt, the date and the reason. We aim to reply within a few working days.

processing.title: How refunds are paid
processing.body: Approved refunds are sent back through the original payment method, JazzCash, EasyPaisa or bank transfer, where possible.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions about this policy? Email {email} or write to {company}, {address}.

faq.title: Pricing questions

currency.a: Each plan shows its price with the currency code, for example PKR for Pakistani rupees.

billing.q: What's the difference between monthly and yearly?
billing.a: Monthly plans are paid every month. Yearly plans are paid once a year, and each plan shows how much you save compared with paying monthly.

trialEnd.q: What happens when my free trial ends?
trialEnd.a: Choose a plan and pay in the app to keep using paid features. Your trial is never charged.

changePlan.q: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.a: Yes. You can move to a different plan in the app as your business grows. Contact us if you'd like help choosing.

custom.q: How does “Build your own plan” work?
custom.a: Some modules are always included, and you add only the others you need. The price updates as you choose, so you only pay for what you use.

approval.q: How long does payment approval take?
approval.a: Our team checks receipts as quickly as possible during working hours, and you can see the status in the app.

refunds.a: Refunds follow our Refund Policy, which explains when they're available and how to ask for one.
